pages.text: Mars sent a launch package, not a rocket.$(br2)The $(bold)Fuel Processing Silo$() turns caldera sulfur and frozen atmosphere into $(bold)Rocket Fuel Cells$(). The rocket needs 6.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA calls this field expedient launch readiness.$()

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Craft the controller first; it holds the processing interface. The shell is plain iron blocks. Of course it is.

pages.title: Shell
pages.text: $(li)A 3x3 iron shell, 4 blocks tall$(li)The whole floor is solid iron$(li)The center column is hollow above the floor$(li)The controller replaces the center block of one outside face$(li)Any $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) attached outside
Higher heater tiers run faster. Capacitors faster still.

pages.title: Feedstock
pages.text: $(bold)Sulfur:$() mine sulfur ore in mature rupture calderas. Smelt or blast the Impure Sulfur it drops.$(br2)$(bold)Atmosphere Shards:$() Phase 6. Carry them in a $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Backup:$() the silo also turns a sulfur lava bucket into impure sulfur.

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: Each makes one, base time:$(li)$(bold)Solid Propellant:$() 4 Sulfur, 2 Coal, 60s$(li)$(bold)Liquid Oxidizer:$() 4 Atmosphere Shards, 90s$(li)$(bold)Fuel Cell:$() 2 Propellant, 2 Oxidizer, 1 Acheronite Shard, 120s$(li)$(bold)Reduction:$() 1 Sulfur Lava Bucket to 2 Impure Sulfur, 90s

pages.title: Fueling
pages.text: Carry the 6 cells to the blast pit and right-click the assembled rocket to load them by hand.$(br2)The silo is the slow part. Budget time, heater fuel and a second sulfur run.
